name: The Context Company
long_description:
We analyze every conversation between your customers and your AI agent to find what's losing you customers and money. Then we help ship the fix and prove it worked.

Nobody on the team can read every conversation once an agent is in production. TCC does, and turns them into patterns tied to the accounts they affect: where customers get stuck, what they wish the agent could do, and where it's spending more than it needs to.

Engineers ask about a pattern from their IDE through our MCP, get the conversations and traces behind it down to the tool call or prompt that went wrong, ship the fix, and benchmark cost and quality before and after. Product sees what customers are actually trying to do with the agent and where it falls short, broken out by topic and account, which becomes the backlog for what to build next. Customer success sees which accounts the agent is struggling with before the customer says anything, and steps in with the full conversation on hand.

Any agent framework, a few lines of code. If you're running an agent in production or about to launch, ping us.
one_liner: Find what's losing you customers and money in your AI agent and fix it

launches.title: The Context Company - Catch Silent AI Failures Before They Break Production
launches.tagline: Full observability for AI agents, from bad tool calls, loops, and hallucinations to latency and cost, in 10 lines of code.
launches.body:
What is up! We’re [Arman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/armankumaraswamy/) and [Rohil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rohil-ag/) - cofounders of [The Context Company](https://thecontextcompany.com)

**TL;DR**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/129e5656-94c6-42e6-a2ba-6ac545b0ef94)

Setup takes under 10 lines of code, and we now support Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, and LangGraph, with more frameworks coming fast.

**Our Ask**

* If you’re building with Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, or LangGraph, use The Context Company for observability.
* Setup takes just a few lines - DM us on Bookface or Slack, or email [founders@thecontextcompany.com](https://mailto:founders@thecontextcompany.com), and we’ll personally onboard you in 15 minutes.
* Not using those frameworks yet? Tell us what you’re building with, and we’ll add support fast.

<https://youtu.be/5FVesVO9egg>

**The Problem**

AI agents often fail quietly. Traditional observability tools only show latency or stack traces. They miss the silent layer of failures that happen inside reasoning steps or tool calls.

Most teams end up waiting until users report issues, and by then, it’s already too late. As a developer, I know you’ve been there scrolling through endless logs, trying to piece together what an agent actually did and why it failed (because trust us, we have too 🙏🏽).

**We’re rethinking observability from the ground up and making silent failures a first-class primitive in agent monitoring.**

\*\*Our Solution:\*\*\
Instead of just visualizing traces, we analyze them and detect reasoning breakdowns across runs. In addition to traditional metrics like latency, cost, and token usage, The Context Company surfaces failures in a clean, developer-friendly dashboard.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/861e36d0-5a8b-4555-a738-e2489729f99f)

And we’ve gone beyond the cloud:

You can now run our developer package locally to debug traces on your machine, even when you’re offline or iterating fast.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/b7722f3f-a018-4c46-806c-7ef4be35bd44)

**Our Progress**

* Framework support: Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, and LangGraph.
* Instant setup: <10 lines of code - no refactoring or modifying your agent needed. This is what it looks like:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/560baa96-5818-4d20-bf82-43f2d3775ca3)

* Local debugging: Run observability locally on your laptop for real-time trace analysis.
* Dashboards: Full visibility into agent runs, tool calls, latency, costs, and semantic failures.

**The Team**\
Arman and Rohil have been best friends since 6th grade (8+ years now!). 

Arman optimized the public-facing AI agent at Mintlify, where he cut failure rates by 82%, and worked with enterprise design partners to build custom agents. Rohil worked on Gmail Intelligence at Google, reducing hallucinations in intent detection by 27% across 26B+ daily emails. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/70e7935c-7606-4e8f-a7af-4ebf44cf5514)

https://www.thecontextcompany.com

P.S. Even if you’re not using AI SDK, LangChain, or LangGraph, we’re adding support for other frameworks soon. Tell us what you need 😎\
